claim_text: This larger, more efficient water recycling plant will deliver a significant step change improvement in internal water recycling and is expected to increase tailings water recycle yield to up to 90% and significantly reduce groundwater abstraction.
context_text: This larger, more efficient water recycling plant will deliver a significant step change improvement in internal water recycling and is expected to increase tailings water recycle yield to up to 90% and significantly reduce groundwater abstraction.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 该表述是对未来效果的预期，报告没有提供FY25已实现的历史绩效数据来证明90%回收率或抽水减少已经发生。
